answer: Proposal: one-per-person credentials from a trusted issuer. Signup scans the iris under a liveness pulse check; the pigment texture is effectively unrepeatable, and the issuer's dedup registry admits one credential per matched iris, while each reward claim re-matches the eye — so a bought key is useless without its owner. The protocol counts only credentialed keys, one capped share each. Extra identities thus cost extra humans per epoch; with the cap near the going wage, aggregation profit hits its nadir, ~zero. Residual leak: matcher false-accepts and liveness spoofs.
